reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant', and no redline or counterparty comment is expected — the rendered redline is identical to the originals and no comment was added, which is correct for this status.

The cited text supports compliance: §14 (p0079) lets Client terminate on notice with service running only to the last day of the following month, with no exit fee, minimum-term buyout, or payment of remaining contract value; §13 (p0078) imposes only operational transition duties on non-renewal, no charge.

No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalty language appears in the cited paragraphs — the §7 spam covenant (p0049) is a conduct prohibition with no per-incident charge, and §5 (p0045) sets ordinary recurring fees.

The rationale correctly distinguishes the monthly minimum fees in p0045 as a pricing/volume commitment rather than a liquidated sum triggered by termination or breach, which is outside the scope of the LD rule; nothing in the record contradicts that reading.
Direction is correctly applied: the rule flags only amounts payable by Customer, and no such amounts exist here, so the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs or penalties) is already met.
